text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove a City-owned tree located at 143 Plewes Road. The application indicates the reason for removal is accommodate a new driveway entrance within the City-owned right-of-way resulting from recent Committee of Adjustment approvals to construct a new detached dwelling with an attached garage. The subject tree is a Freeman maple (Acer x freemanii), measuring 21 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, referred Item NY16.13 back to the North York Community Council for further consideration.
